concerns.text: Task T002 claims to satisfy FR-001 but weakens it by aborting the global NOAA NCEP/NCAR download when the source is missing ("If the global NOAA NCEP/NCAR source is missing, log DEV‑001 and abort the global download (as required by FR‑001)"). FR‑001 mandates that the system MUST download the global pressure dataset; aborting constitutes a semantic weakening of the requirement.

FR‑011 (climate‑index stratification of control windows) is not implemented by any task. T004 only logs a proxy control flag (PROXY_NOT_FULFILLING_FR011) and does not perform the required ENSO/PDO matching, leaving the functional requirement uncovered.
